first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender dark gray long gun held by Person A, with a mottled surface, a long barrel, and a protruding sighting component at the front visible.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, uneven ground from the foreground to the midground, scattered with gravel and rocks, with wet, bright reflections in places.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: A collection comprising nearby ruined walls on the left and right and gray-black damaged walls in the mid-to-far background, some retaining rectangular door and window openings.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: A cluster of gray-black, leafless, slender tree trunks with sparse short branches in the mid-to-far background.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: A smoke-cloud background in the upper portion, ranging from brighter gray-white to darker yellow-green.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: A collection of orange-yellow open flames on the muddy ground and near the ruined walls, excluding the discrete airborne sparks.

entities.name: damaged vertical flag
entities.identification: A long, narrow cloth flag on a slender flagpole in the upper left, with alternating dark and light bands and uneven fabric edges.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The first-person person holding Weapon A; a portion of a dark-gloved hand can be consistently identified in this clip.

entities.name: shower of sparks
entities.identification: Discrete orange-yellow glowing particles above the flames, appearing as dots and short lines.
